dedupe_keys.name: pye python energyplus co simulation and optimisation with ml surrogate models

description: PyE+ is a Python framework that couples EnergyPlus with Python for co-simulation, multi-objective optimisation with NSGA-II, and machine-learning surrogate models that speed up evaluation of building energy performance and occupant comfort. It was written by Mubashir Hussain Wani; version 1.0.1 was archived on Zenodo on 14 July 2025 as the first stable citable release. Users vary U-values, lighting and plug loads, infiltration and HVAC setpoints; the tool runs EnergyPlus through eppy and the EnergyPlus Python API, optimises with DEAP and scikit-learn surrogates, and shows live Pareto fronts and RMSE trends in a Tkinter interface. Coverage: any building with an EnergyPlus model; two example IDF files are included, one of a real building in Wellington. Access: GitHub and Zenodo. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: a single-author research tool with two releases. Simulation uses: retrofit and control optimisation of buildings, and faster screening of design options with surrogates. Related records: BESOS, the MPC buildings flexibility testbed and EnergyPlus.
